definitions.explanation: Killing animals as an official measure: livestock culled to stop the spread of a disease such as bird flu, or stray and unwanted pets put down at animal shelters. A bureaucratic term; the verb is {殺処分|さつしょぶん}する, often in the passive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{十万羽|じゅうまんわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: About a hundred thousand birds were culled because of bird flu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧や⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{譲渡会|じょうとかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Adoption events are held to bring the number of rescued dogs and cats put down to zero.

notes:
USAGE:
The word is official and impersonal; it appears in news reports about livestock epidemics and in campaigns about animal shelters. Everyday speech about a pet being put to sleep prefers the gentler ⟦{安楽死|あんらくし}→安楽死：18174_anrakushi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be culled, to be put down
- {殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero animals put down (a shelter campaign slogan)
- {豚熱|とんねつ}・⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{殺処分|さつしょぶん}: culling because of swine fever or bird flu
